title: docs(skills): data-hooks says which refused regex patterns are errors and which only warn
body:
Fixes #36727

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:使用数据技能包的 AI 助手,以前被告知「钩子脚本里写错的正则只会得到警告」,现在被告知实情:运行时也拒绝的正则会在保存和校验时直接报错,只有三种运行时其实能跑的写法才是警告。
- 为什么做:上一张已合并的卡把这类正则从警告改成了报错,技能包里这句话没跟上,AI 会照旧说法写出发布时被拦下的脚本。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是 AI 读到的说明仍不够准确,不影响任何运行行为;可以直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

One bullet of `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, "Refused when it does not compile". Its last sentence said "A regex pattern the checking engine refuses is a warning: the runtime may accept it." That stopped being true when the compile rules were narrowed (merge commit `fe190968eb`, `packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.ts`).

The sentence now reads: "A regex pattern the runtime refuses too is that error; only a duplicate named group, a modifier group (`(?i:a)`) or a Unicode property name only the runtime knows (any refused one on a pre-17.0-Unicode host) warns."

Checked against the landed code, not the card's words:

- `judgeBodyCompile` answers `warning` for the shape `regexp-dialect-gap` alone; `regexp-pattern` and every other shape is `error`.
- The warning arm is the two V8 reasons `Duplicate capture group name` and `Invalid group` (`REGEXP_DIALECT_GAP_REASONS`), plus a property-name refusal where every refused name is on `REGEXP_PROPERTY_NAMES_ONLY_QUICKJS_KNOWS`.
- `hostUnicodeAtLeastMeasured()` false (host Unicode tables older than 17.0, or none named) makes every property-name refusal a warning.
- The hook and job rules read the same `judgeBodyCompile`, so "that error" is `hook-body-does-not-compile` (the three commands and a runtime save, `422 INVALID_METADATA`) and `job-body-does-not-compile` (the three commands), as the bullet already said.

The file had 1 token of headroom, so the new sentence is paid for inside the same bullet. Dropped: "naming the hook, the `SyntaxError` and its line", the spelled-out rename example (`const data = ctx.input || {};`), and a few connecting words. Nothing outside the bullet moved, and no ceiling moved.

| `data-hooks.md` lines | 885 | 885 |

A changeset is included (`@objectstack/skills`, patch), as every earlier edit of this file carries one.

## Tests

Prose only: no tested behaviour changed, so no test and no ablation. Head `15b10bbc584`.

## Acceptance notes

- The bullet teaches the hook and job rules only, as before. The action rule takes the same split; its paragraph in this file points here and was not touched.
- The twelve measured property-name spellings are not listed in the skill: the token ceiling has no room, and the lint finding names the pattern. They are in `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx`.

## Verification

Read first: the one hunk in `data-hooks.md`, against `judgeBodyCompile` and `isRegexpDialectGap` in `packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.ts`.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0 and prints `data-hooks.md is 10122 tokens (ceiling 10122; headroom 0)`.

Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, reconciled with `--ran`): 48 derived, 44 run and exit 0, 4 NOT MEASURED (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they read a whole-workspace build this one-file prose edit did not make; CI runs them).
